name: Takesaka Wakana
source: The second daughter of the Takesaka household. Although living in overseas as a professional tennis player, she returns home whenever her younger brother is in a pinch. Actually this time, she is the one who makes the excuse about her younger brother's predicament.
translation: The second daughter of the Takesaka household. Although living in overseas as a professional tennis player, she returns home whenever her younger brother is in a pinch. Actually this time, she is the one who makes the excuse about her younger brother's predicament.
